dish.make_ahead: Pâté up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Trim the livers and sear in butter for 2 minutes a side until still pink.
Add the shallots and thyme, then the brandy, and let it bubble off.
Blitz with the soft butter until silky, season and press into a dish.
Pour over the clarified butter and chill for 4 hours.
Toast the rye and serve with the pâté.

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days ahead, better the next day

steps.text: Brown the lamb in batches in oil.
Layer in a heavy pot with the onions, carrots and potatoes.
Pour over the stout and stock, cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours until tender.
Finish with parsley.

dish.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; bake to serve

steps.text: Soak the raisins in the whiskey for 30 minutes.
Butter the brioche and layer in a dish with the raisins.
Whisk the eggs, milk, cream and sugar and pour over.
Rest for 30 minutes.
Bake at 170C until puffed and golden.

dish.n: Tom Reagan's hot Irish whiskey toddy

steps.text: Boil the water. Cut four lemon wheels and stud each with cloves.
Into four heatproof glasses put whiskey, honey and lemon juice.
Top with the hot water and stir until the honey dissolves.
Float a studded wheel on top, add a cinnamon stick and serve hot.
Brown the shanks in the oil.
Soften the sliced onion and garlic.
Add the wine, tomatoes and rosemary, cover and braise at 160C.
Cook the polenta in salted water, stir in the butter.
Serve the shanks on top of the polenta.
Peel the pears, keeping the stalks.
Simmer the wine with the water, sugar, cinnamon and orange peel, add the pears and poach, turning.
Reduce the syrup.
Serve the pears with mascarpone and syrup.
Stir the Chianti with the juice, brandy and honey until the honey dissolves.
Add the sliced orange, diced apple and cinnamon stick.
Chill for at least 2 hours, which is the resting time.
Pour over ice in wine glasses, spooning some fruit into each. For non-drinkers, make it with sour cherry juice and blood orange juice topped with soda.
Cut the cod into bite-sized pieces.
Whisk some of the flour with the lager to a thin batter.
Dust the fish in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C until crisp.
Drain and serve with lemon wedges and tartare.

dish.n: Blue Hawaiian with rum and pineapple

steps.text: For each drink, measure 30ml white rum, 20ml blue curacao, 90ml pineapple juice and 30ml coconut cream into a shaker.
Shake each drink hard with ice until frothy.
Strain into tall glasses full of crushed ice and garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cherry.

dish.make_ahead: Pork and eggs up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Braise the pork belly in the soy, mirin, sake and water, covered, on a low simmer.
Soft-boil the eggs, peel and marinate in some of the braising liquid.
Slice the pork. Heat the stock and season with a little soy.
Cook the noodles and divide between bowls.
Top with pork, halved egg, nori and spring onion.
Pack four tall glasses with ice, stir to chill, then pour off any water.
Add the whisky to each and stir.
Top slowly with very cold soda water down the spoon. Squeeze a strip of lemon peel over each.
Soak the gelatine in cold water.
Warm the water with the sugar, squeeze the gelatine and stir in to dissolve.
Cool slightly, then gently stir in the sparkling wine.
Pour into coupes over raspberries.
Chill.
Make the syrup ahead by dissolving equal parts sugar and hot water, then cool.
Shake the gin, lemon juice and syrup hard with ice.
Strain into tall glasses over fresh ice and top with soda water.

dish.n: Miracle Mets pretzels with beer mustard

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt and warm water and knead.
Rise in a covered bowl until doubled.
Shape into 8 pretzels.
Boil each briefly in the water with the bicarb, then drain and sprinkle with coarse salt.
Bake at 220C until deep brown.
Mix the mustard, lager and honey for the dip.

dish.make_ahead: Lemon mix up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Stir the lemon juice, sugar and water until the sugar dissolves.
Chill 4 glasses in the freezer.
Pour lager into each glass and top with lemonade. Add a splash of the lemon mix.
Add a sprig of mint and a lemon wheel.
Brown the chicken in oil
Soften the mushrooms and leeks
Add the wine and cream and simmer until thick
Tip into a dish, cover with puff pastry and brush with egg
Bake at 200C until golden
Put the cherries, orange and cinnamon in a jug
Add the Shiraz, brandy and sugar and stir to dissolve
Chill
Add the soda water just before serving and stir
Pour into heavy glasses over ice with some fruit in each

dish.n: Dinner for twelve braised short ribs

steps.text: Season and brown the short ribs in batches.
Add the wine, stock, garlic and thyme. Cover and braise at 150C until tender.
Lift out the ribs, skim the fat and reduce the sauce until glossy, then return the ribs to coat.
Cook the polenta in the water, stirring, then beat in the butter and parmesan.
Spoon the ribs over the polenta.
Juice the lemons. Shake the bourbon, lemon juice, syrup and egg white hard without ice for 10 seconds, one drink at a time.
Add ice and shake again.
Strain over a large ice cube in a heavy glass and dot the foam with bitters.
Wash the rice until the water runs clear.
Cook with the water and sake.
Boil the eggs for a soft yolk, cool and peel.
Serve the rice in small bowls with furikake, a pickled plum and a halved egg.
Mix the salt with the chilli powder on a plate.
Rub the rims of four tall glasses with lime, dip in the salt and fill with ice.
Juice the grapefruits and limes.
Pour the tequila, grapefruit juice, lime juice and agave syrup into each glass.
Top with soda water, stir and add a grapefruit wedge.

film: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels (1998)

steps.text: Brown the beef with the sliced onions and thyme.
Add the ale and braise.
Thicken with the flour, pour into a dish, cover with puff pastry and bake at 200C.
Cut thick chips and fry twice until golden.
Cook the peas and crush with the butter and mint.

film: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels (1998)

dish.n: Two smoking barrels peated whisky sour

steps.text: Mix the honey with warm water for honey syrup.
Shake the whisky, lemon juice, syrup and egg white hard without ice, one drink at a time.
Shake again with ice and strain into a tumbler over ice.
Dot the foam with aromatic bitters.
Slice the garlic and chop the parsley.
Cook the linguine in salted water until al dente.
Toast the panko in oil until golden.
Heat the butter and oil, add the garlic and chilli flakes and cook briefly.
Add the prawns and cook until pink.
Add the wine and bubble.
Toss in the drained pasta with a splash of pasta water, lemon zest and juice and the parsley.
Top with the crumbs.

dish.make_ahead: Syrup up to 1 week ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Chill the flutes. Shake the gin, lemon juice and sugar syrup with ice and strain into each flute.
Top slowly with chilled champagne or sparkling wine.
Add a long twist of lemon peel.
For anyone not drinking, mix lemon juice and syrup with sparkling white grape juice.
Cut the fish into strips. Whisk the flour, beer and salt into a batter.
Toss the cabbage with lime juice and salt.
Mix the mayonnaise with the chipotle.
Dip the fish in batter and fry in 180C oil until golden, in batches.
Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, chipotle mayo and coriander.

dish.make_ahead: Jug can be mixed ahead for the esky

steps.text: Rub the tumbler rims with lime and dip in flaky salt. Fill with ice.
Shake the tequila, lime juice, orange liqueur and agave with ice.
Strain over the ice and garnish with a lime wheel.

dish.make_ahead: Gratin can be made 1 day ahead

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thin and layer in a dish with the cream, garlic and salt.
Mash the butter with chopped tarragon and push under the chicken skin.
Roast the chicken at 220C, then at 180C, with the gratin on the lower shelf until tender and golden.
Rest the chicken.
Add the wine and Dijon to the tray, scrape and reduce by half.
Steam the beans and serve.

dish.n: I will find you fresh lemon soda

steps.text: Squeeze the lemons.
Fill four tall glasses with ice and add lemon juice and sugar syrup to each.
Add cognac to the glasses that want it.
Top with cold soda water, stir and add a lemon wheel.
Soften the onion, fennel and garlic in the oil.
Add the tomatoes, wine and stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the mussels and clams, cover and cook until they open.
Add the prawns and snapper and cook just until done. Serve with sourdough.
Brew the coffee.
For each glass stir sugar into hot coffee with whiskey.
Pour the cream over the back of a spoon so it floats.
Heat the oven to 200C. Season the beef and roast until 52C inside.
Rest the beef under foil.
Roast the potatoes in oil.
Whisk the eggs, flour and milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C.
Reduce the red wine with the pan juices for gravy.
Put a sugar cube in each of 4 coupes and soak with bitters.
Add cognac to each.
Slowly top with cold champagne.
Twist lemon peel over and drop it in. Use sparkling apple juice and a dash of bitters for the younger crowd.

dish.make_ahead: Flamed rum, stand back and keep hair tied

steps.text: Melt the butter, sugar and cinnamon in a wide pan until bubbling.
Halve the bananas lengthways and cook, spooning the sauce over.
Pour in the rum and carefully light it with a long match, standing back.
When the flames die down, spoon over bowls of ice cream and scatter with pecans.
Fill four tall glasses with ice.
Add melon liqueur, vodka and a squeeze of lime to each.
Top with lemonade, stir and add an umbrella.

dish.make_ahead: Filling a day ahead, top and bake fresh

steps.text: Brown the beef in the oil with the onions, then stir in the flour.
Add the brown ale and water to cover and simmer until tender.
Pour into a dish and top with puff pastry. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and milk. Cook the peas and serve everything together.

dish.n: Aether blood orange and cranberry spritz

steps.text: Shake the vodka, juices and lime juice hard with ice, in batches.
Strain into wine glasses full of ice and top with soda water.
Garnish with a blood orange wheel and a rosemary sprig. Leave out the vodka for a booze-free version.
Boil the potatoes until just tender, drain, smash flat on a tray, drizzle with oil and roast at 220C.
Season the steaks and sear in a hot pan on both sides.
Add most of the butter, the garlic and thyme and baste briefly. Rest the steaks.
Add the wine and stock to the pan and reduce by half.
Saute the beans in the remaining butter. Serve with the steaks and potatoes.
Drop raspberries into each flute and add a splash of grapefruit juice.
Slowly top with chilled sparkling rose. For anyone not drinking, use pink lemonade instead.
Rub a small rosemary sprig between your hands and add one to each glass.
Brown the beef and bacon.
Add the mushrooms and cook until golden.
Pour in the red wine.
Simmer gently until tender and glossy.
Boil and mash the potatoes with plenty of butter and serve under the beef.
Rub the rims of the glasses with lime and dip in salt.
For each drink, measure 45ml tequila, 20ml blue curacao, the juice of 1 lime and 10ml sugar syrup into a shaker.
Shake each drink hard with ice for 10 seconds, then strain over fresh ice.
Garnish with a lime wheel.
Cut the limes into wedges.
Gently muddle the mint, lime and sugar in each glass.
Add the rum and fill with crushed ice.
Top with soda water and stir from the bottom.
Slice the orange.
Pour the juices into a big bowl with ice and sliced orange. Top with lemonade.
Add the vodka to the adults' bowl only.
Chill the flutes in the freezer.
Pour the cassis into each glass, tilt and top slowly with champagne so it does not foam over.
Drop a raspberry into each glass and serve straight away.
Gently muddle the mint leaves with the syrup and lime juice in a jug, without shredding the mint.
Add the rum and divide between glasses filled with crushed ice.
Top with soda water, stir gently and garnish with a mint sprig.

dish.n: Fruit cake from home with brandy butter
dish.make_ahead: Brandy butter up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Beat the soft butter with icing sugar until pale, then beat in the brandy a little at a time until fluffy.
Chill the brandy butter for 20 minutes.
Wrap the fruit cake in foil.
Warm at 160C.
Cut into thick slices and serve with the brandy butter and cheddar wedges.
Boil the water with the hibiscus, ginger and sugar, then turn off and steep.
Strain and chill.
Stir in the pineapple juice and lime juice.
Pour over ice, top with sparkling water and add a lime wheel. Add rum per glass for the adults if you like.
Steep the tea bags, remove and stir in the sugar until dissolved.
Cool, then chill.
Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, add bourbon and tea to each and squeeze in a lemon wedge.
Slap a mint sprig between your hands and drop it in. Leave out the bourbon for non-drinkers.

dish.n: The Vesper gin and vodka martini

steps.text: Shake the gin, vodka and vermouth hard with ice until very cold, in batches if needed.
Strain into deep chilled coupes and add a long strip of lemon peel to each.

dish.n: Top End lemon myrtle gin and tonic

steps.text: Mix the sugar and lemon myrtle on a plate. Run a lime around each glass rim and dip.
Fill the glasses with ice, add gin and lime juice.
Top with tonic and add a lime wheel.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water for a syrup.
Stir the bourbon, syrup and bitters with ice in a jug until very cold.
Strain into 4 heavy tumblers over one large ice cube each.
Squeeze orange peel over each, rub the rim and drop it in.
Slice the onions into thick rings and soak in the buttermilk
Whisk the flour with the cold lager and salt
Heat the oil to 185C
Drain the onions, dip in the batter and fry in small batches until puffed and golden
Drain and salt lightly

film: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them (2016)

dish.make_ahead: Syrup up to 1 week, keep chilled

steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in the hot water.
Cool the syrup.
Squeeze the lemons into a jug and add the syrup.
Add plenty of ice and top with soda water.
Pour into teacups and add a splash of gin to the grown-ups' cups.

dish.make_ahead: Mix per glass, rum-free version on request

ingredients.item: sugar syrup (from caster sugar and water)

steps.text: Make the sugar syrup by dissolving equal parts caster sugar and hot water, then cool.
Shake the rum, juices and syrup over ice, one drink at a time.
Strain over crushed ice and top with mint. Make a rum-free version for anyone not drinking.

dish.n: Are you not entertained spiced honey wine

steps.text: Pour the wine into a pot with the honey, peppercorns, bay leaves, saffron and orange peel.
Warm gently for 15 minutes without boiling.
Strain into cups and serve warm.
Fill tall glasses with ice and squeeze lime juice into each.
Add a dash of bitters and ginger beer to each glass.
Float dark rum over the top so it clouds down through the glass.
Garnish with a lime wedge and crystallised ginger.

film: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban (2004)

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches.
Soften the onions and carrots with the thyme.
Return the beef, add the ale and stock, cover and braise at 160C.
Serve with crusty bread and butter.

film: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days (2003)

steps.text: Chill 4 tall cups or glasses.
Squeeze a quarter of a lime into each, then pour in the lager, tilting the cup.
Top with the ginger beer, drop in a lime wedge and mint sprig and serve straight away.
Frost four glasses in the freezer.
Dissolve the sugar in hot water and cool.
Squeeze 4 lemons and mix the juice with the syrup and soda water.
Half fill each glass with cold lager and top with the lemon mix and lemonade.
Add a lemon wheel and serve on the porch.
Chill coupe glasses in the freezer.
Fill a jug with ice and add bourbon, vermouth and bitters, then stir steadily until very cold.
Strain into the glasses, drop in a cherry and twist a strip of orange peel over the top.

dish.n: Magda's New Year's Eve champagne punch

steps.text: In a large punch bowl, mix the brandy, the peach liqueur, the fresh orange juice and the sliced ripe peaches.
Chill 1 hour.
Just before serving add a big block of ice and pour in a chilled the bottle of sparkling wine and the soda water.
Stir once gently.
Ladle into coupes with a slice of peach in.
For non-drinkers, use peach nectar and sparkling apple juice.
Mix the salt and chilli powder on a saucer. Rub a lime wedge around each glass rim and dip into the salt.
Fill the glasses with ice. Add lime juice, tomato juice, a couple of dashes of hot sauce and a dash of Worcestershire to each.
Top each with a bottle of cold lager, stir gently and serve with a lime wedge.
In each tall glass muddle mint leaves with lime wedges and sugar until the sugar dissolves.
Fill with crushed ice and pour in the rum.
Top with soda water and stir from the bottom with a long spoon. Garnish with a mint sprig and a lime wheel.
Cut the pineapple into wedges for garnish.
Blend the rum, pineapple juice, coconut cream, lime juice, syrup and ice until thick and smooth.
Pour into four tall glasses and garnish with a pineapple wedge, a cherry and a paper umbrella. Swap the rum for extra pineapple juice to make it alcohol-free.
Stir the gin and vermouth over ice, one drink at a time.
Strain into a chilled glass with a cocktail onion.
For anyone off the gin, pour sparkling water over ice with onions.
Touch the rim of the chilled glasses with a little honey and lime.
For each drink, stir the gin with a splash of dry vermouth over ice and strain in.
Serve iced lime soda the same way for anyone off the gin.

film: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest (2006)

dish.make_ahead: Make a day ahead, rum added at serving

ingredients.item: dark rum, optional for the grown-ups

steps.text: Steep the hibiscus, ginger, cloves and orange peel in the boiling water for 30 minutes.
Strain, stir in the sugar and chill.
Serve over ice, with a splash of dark rum for the grown-ups.
Juice the limes and scoop out the passionfruit pulp. Cut pineapple wedges for garnish.
Shake the rum, pineapple juice, passionfruit, lime juice and grenadine with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into tumblers packed with crushed ice, grate nutmeg on top and garnish with a pineapple wedge.
Juice the lemons and slice the apple thinly
Press the mint gently with the syrup and lemon juice in a shaker, one drink at a time
Add bourbon and ice, shake hard, and strain into rocks glasses packed with crushed ice
Garnish with a mint sprig and an apple slice
Whisk the flour with cold lager to a light batter.
Mix the sour cream with lime juice for a crema.
Dip the fish strips and fry at 180C in batches until crisp.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with cabbage, fish, crema and salsa.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.
Shake the whisky, lemon juice and 40ml of the syrup with ice for 10 seconds.
Strain into four ice-filled highballs, top with lemonade and soda, stir once and add a lemon wheel.
Steep the jasmine tea in water just off the boil, then strain.
Chill the tea.
Stir the honey into a little hot water to loosen it.
Fill four highball glasses with ice and add rye, cold jasmine tea, honey syrup and lemon juice to each.
Stir, top with soda water and add a strip of lemon peel.
Fill four tall glasses with ice and add whiskey and lime juice to each.
Top with cold ginger beer and stir once.
Garnish with a lime wedge and a thin slice of fresh ginger.

film: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (2019)

steps.text: Soften the fennel and garlic in the oil. Add the saffron, tomatoes and wine.
Simmer to a rich broth.
Add the fish, prawns and mussels, cover and cook until the mussels open.
Toast the bread, rub with a cut garlic clove and serve alongside.
Rub the glass rims with lime and dip in salt.
Blend the tequila, the juice of the remaining limes, orange liqueur, sugar syrup and ice until smooth and slushy.
Pour into the glasses and garnish with lime wheels. Serve immediately.
Warm the heatproof glasses with hot water and tip it out.
Add brown sugar and whiskey to each, pour in hot coffee and stir until the sugar dissolves.
Lightly whip the cream until just thickened but still pourable.
Pour slowly over the back of a spoon so it floats on top. For anyone not drinking, make hot chocolate instead.
Put four martini glasses in the freezer.
Stir the gin, vermouth and brine over ice in a jug until very cold.
Strain into the frozen glasses and garnish each with three olives on a pick.
Peel strips of zest from the orange.
Simmer the apple juice with the honey, 2 cinnamon sticks, cloves and zest.
Turn the heat to low and add the ale, warming through without boiling.
Ladle into mugs and add a cinnamon stick to each. For non-drinkers, swap the ale for ginger beer and serve over ice.

film: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad! (1988)

steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.
Blend the syrup with the lemon juice, vodka, cold water and ice until slushy.
Pour into cups, garnish with lemon wheels and serve with straws.
Cut the onions into thick rings and soak in the buttermilk.
Whisk the flour with the cold lager.
Dip the rings in the batter and fry at 185C in batches until puffed and golden.
Salt and serve hot.
Slice the onions and brown the beef in oil.
Brown.
Add the onions, ale and water to cover and simmer.
Thicken with the flour, spoon into a pie dish and top with pastry brushed with egg.
Bake at 200C.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter, and cook the peas.
Cook.

dish.n: Rationed pretzels with beer cheese dip

steps.text: Cut the dough into bite-size pieces.
Simmer the water with the bicarb and drop the pieces in briefly, in batches. Drain.
Lay on a lined tray, brush with egg, sprinkle with sea salt and bake at 220C.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the lager and milk.
Add the cheddar, mustard and paprika and stir until smooth.
Juice the lemons and mix the juice with the syrup, then chill
Chill four pint glasses in the freezer
Pour some lemon mix into each glass, add soda water, then top slowly with cold lager
Stir once and add a lemon wheel. Use extra soda water and lemon for anyone driving
Put honey and lemon juice in each of 4 mugs.
Add bourbon to each and top with just boiled water.
Drop in a cinnamon stick and a lemon wheel studded with cloves. For Mattie use hot apple juice in place of the bourbon and water.

ingredients.item: mint leaves, plus sprigs to garnish

steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in hot water and cool.
For each drink, muddle lemon wedges with mint leaves and syrup in a shaker.
Add bourbon and ice and shake hard for 10 seconds.
Pour into a short glass and top with crushed ice.
Garnish with a mint sprig.
Juice the lemons. Make two drinks at a time.
Shake the whisky, lemon juice, maple syrup and egg white without ice for 15 seconds.
Add ice and shake again until very cold.
Strain over fresh ice into rocks glasses and add 3 drops of bitters to the foam. Repeat for the other two.
